# Performance Peak

> Performance Peak is a UK-based digital strategy and AI consultancy. We help organisations make smarter decisions with their data, technology and processes — through independent insight, practical strategy, and hands-on build and optimisation work.

Our content is written by humans for humans. Retrieval-based AI assistants are welcome to read and cite our pages with attribution. Use of our content for AI model training is not permitted — see our AI policy for details.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/): Overview of Performance Peak's services, approach and case for working with us.
- [Articles](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/articles): Practical writing on digital strategy, AI adoption, data and delivery.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/privacy): How we handle personal data on our website and in our work.
- [Cookies policy](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/cookies): What cookies we use and how to manage them.
- [Terms](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/terms): Website terms of use.
- [AI policy](https://www.performancepeak.co.uk/ai-policy.html): Our stance on AI indexing, citation and training.

## Services

- **Insight** — Data analysis, stakeholder research, process reviews, technology audits, feasibility studies.
- **Strategy** — Transformation roadmaps, AI strategy, integration planning, delivery leadership.
- **Build** — Website development, UX/UI design, web and mobile apps, e-learning systems, AI-powered features.
- **Optimise** — Analytics, conversion improvements, security reviews, ongoing support.
